system.description: You sing a song that rips the sky open. Whatever the result, roll a d2 afterwards: on a 1, your eyes are burned white and you lose this ritual.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and the god is in a generous mood.
outcomes.success: A portal opens to a divine realm, and you may seek an audience with its god.
outcomes.failure: The sky tears, then heals; no portal opens.
outcomes.ruin: The portal opens onto the wrong realm. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
